Participant Pick-up: SLPs and volunteers went to the lobby to pick up participants. Everyone stopped by a table in the hallway to listen to the CWRU researcher introduce the survey study to parents. Once the study was introduced, the SLPs and volunteers proceeded to the breakroom to begin Club ChAT activities.
ACC Device Set-Up: Clinicians and volunteers spent time mounting and setting up the eye-gaze AAC devices and locating devices with parents' support.
Hello Song: SLP (Erin) introduced the Hello Song to the group, sang along, and modeled the song's lyrics (e.g., "clap your hands"). Participants listened to the song and followed along.

Introductions: SLP (Erin) had participant 16 introduced themselves first to the group and supported other participant introductions by stating their name and "hello." SLP (Valerie) modeled introductions on participants' eye-gaze (19, 17) and switch devices (18).
Adding Friends to AAC Devices: SLPs asked participants if they would like their new friends to their devices and spent some time adding new names.
Nature Sounds: SLP presented nature sounds on her computer and asked participants what they were.
Painting: Participants were provided with paint brushes and paint to paint flower pots. Before painting, they were asked if they wanted to wear a t-shirt to protect their clothing.
Nature Walk: SLPs, participants, and volunteers walked to the playground for a nature walk and point out the core words that were introduced during the nature sound activity.
